exposure: estimated blood loss before BBT insertion
Cause of postpartum hemorrhage (uterine atony, placenta previa, PAS, coagulopathy)
cohort: 487 women who underwent BBT for persistent postpartum hemorrhage out of 48,511 deliveries at a hospital in Shanghai, China.
finding: Bakri balloon tamponade (BBT) was effective for postpartum hemorrhage, particularly for uterine atony and placenta previa, with estimated blood loss before BBT insertion, DIC development, IVF pregnancy, and PAS identified as independent risk factors for BBT failure.
